persona: Matches the Fresh Graduate CV (entry-level frontend)
title: Frontend Developer Intern
job_text:
Zone24x7 is hiring a Frontend Developer Intern to join our product engineering team in Colombo.

About the role:
You'll work alongside senior engineers building customer-facing features in React and TypeScript. This is a great opportunity for a final-year undergraduate or recent graduate to get hands-on experience in a production codebase.

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain reusable UI components using React and TypeScript
- Fix bugs and address feedback from QA and design reviews
- Write unit tests using Jest and React Testing Library
- Participate in code reviews and daily standups

Requirements:
- Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field
- Basic knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
- Familiarity with React is a plus but not required
- Comfortable using Git for version control
- Eager to learn and receptive to feedback

Nice to have:
- Personal or coursework projects on GitHub
- Exposure to Figma or other design tools

persona: Matches the Junior Developer CV (~1.5 years experience)
title: Junior Software Engineer — Full-Stack
job_text:
99X Technology is looking for a Junior Software Engineer to join a full-stack product team building a SaaS platform used by thousands of customers.

About the role:
You'll own small-to-medium features end-to-end across our React frontend and Node.js/Express backend, working closely with senior engineers and a product manager.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and ship features across the React frontend and Node.js backend
- Write and maintain REST APIs backed by PostgreSQL
- Participate in an on-call rotation and help triage production issues
- Contribute to test coverage and code review

Requirements:
- 1-2 years of professional software engineering experience
- Solid JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals
- Experience with React and Node.js in a production setting
- Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases
- Familiarity with Git-based workflows and CI/CD

Nice to have:
- Experience with Docker
- Exposure to Agile/Scrum ceremonies

persona: Matches the Mid-Level CV (~3.8 years experience)
title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
job_text:
IFS is hiring a Full-Stack Software Engineer to work on the scheduling and operations module of our enterprise ERP product.

About the role:
You'll design and build features spanning our React frontend, Node.js/Python services, and PostgreSQL data layer, and collaborate directly with cross-functional teams on architecture decisions.

Responsibilities:
- Design and implement REST and GraphQL APIs
- Build responsive UIs in React and TypeScript
- Own features end-to-end from design through deployment
- Improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment reliability
- Mentor junior engineers and participate in design reviews

Requirements:
- 3+ years of professional full-stack development experience
- Strong experience with React, Node.js, and either Python or a similar backend language
- Experience with PostgreSQL and designing relational schemas
- Familiarity with Docker and containerized deployments
- Comfortable working with Kubernetes-based infrastructure is a plus
- Experience mentoring or reviewing the work of junior engineers

Nice to have:
- Experience with GraphQL
- Exposure to microservices architecture
- Experience with Redis or other caching layers

persona: Matches the Senior Engineer CV (~6.9 years experience)
title: Senior Software Engineer — API Platform
job_text:
WSO2 is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our API Gateway platform team, owning critical infrastructure used by enterprise customers worldwide.

About the role:
You'll lead technical design for the gateway's rate-limiting and analytics subsystems, working within a small pod of engineers while representing the team in broader architecture discussions.

Responsibilities:
- Architect and build distributed, high-throughput backend services
- Lead design reviews and drive technical decisions within your pod
- Optimize system performance and reliability under heavy load
- Mentor engineers and participate in technical interviews
- Represent the team in cross-org architecture review

Requirements:
- 5+ years of professional backend/distributed-systems experience
- Strong experience with Java, Go, or a similar statically-typed language
- Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts (caching, rate-limiting, consistency)
- Experience with Kubernetes, Kafka, and container orchestration at scale
- Track record of leading technical initiatives and mentoring engineers

Nice to have:
- Experience with API gateway or service-mesh technologies
- Public speaking or technical writing (blog posts, RFCs, design docs)
- Experience running on-call/incident response processes

persona: Matches the Staff/Lead Engineer CV (~10.4 years experience)
title: Staff Engineer — Platform Architecture
job_text:
WSO2 is hiring a Staff Engineer to set technical direction across our platform organization, spanning multiple product squads.

About the role:
You'll define architecture standards, lead major infrastructure initiatives, and coach engineering managers and senior engineers across a 20+ person engineering org.

Responsibilities:
- Set technical direction and architecture standards across multiple teams
- Lead migrations of critical infrastructure with minimal customer disruption
- Coach engineering managers and senior engineers on technical growth
- Drive org-wide initiatives around reliability, scalability, and developer experience
- Represent engineering in cross-functional planning with product and leadership

Requirements:
- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including senior/staff-level scope
- Deep expertise in distributed systems and large-scale infrastructure (Kubernetes, Kafka, multi-region deployments)
- Demonstrated experience leading technical initiatives spanning multiple teams
- Strong track record of mentoring and growing other engineers, including engineering managers
- Excellent written and verbal communication for driving cross-team alignment

Nice to have:
- Experience with capacity planning and org-level technical roadmapping
- Authored internal standards or guidelines adopted across an engineering org
- Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Terraform)
